$Comment: Yeti Bait, the price of the Yeti Cave: Bram the Shepherd takes one to open the cave for a party (EntryCost in ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/Christmas_Yeti_Cave.json, so change the count there), and sells it at his Christmas stall once a player has brought his reindeer their carrots (ShopEntries/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Offer_Yeti_Bait.json). A plain item that only sits in the bag: no BlockType, so it can never be placed or eaten, and no recipe. It wears the game's own raw fish (its model, texture and icon; the Yeti wears a fish on his necklace), so it needs no art of its own. Its words are in items.lang. MaxStack is how many fit in one slot; DropOnDeath false keeps it in the bag when its owner falls.
